# Qualify a resolution before the unknown payload, not a lost-frame decoder

B/C question-first construction,30October2026. B proposed pre-payload
qualification of the unitary-invariant recovery PROPERTY; C and root
independently reconstruct the held-out Bell argument. This is ordinary
held-out testing combined with the actual common-frame interface. It is
not a new general statistical principle or an executed quantum experiment.

## 1. The acquired property

For a fixed channel F:k->B define

`f*(F)=sup_(R CPTP) F_e(R F,I_k/k)`.

It is invariant under an isometry/unitary change of F's occupied output
frame. The frame and an optimizing R need not be known to evaluate a
sound LOWER confidence bound: any physical candidate R supplies one.

Predeclare a FINITE collection of rational filter resolutions a_i and
their finite random thresholds t_i, plus all sample/error budgets. Let
F_i be the corresponding ideal actual-source filtered channels from
B_SPECTRAL_PORT.md. Each has known support cap floor(1/a_i)+1, without
an exact-rank promise on the original N. The source is the SAME fixed
memoryless N during qualification and all future service.

## 2. One qualification batch has a shared frame

For candidate i acquire N_i training Choi programs and v_i HELD-OUT
Choi programs by actual calls of F_i, with their logical Bell references
untouched. Perform ONE reference-joint compression on ALL these outputs.
The exact common-frame identity gives the mathematical state

`integral J_(F_i,U)^tensor(N_i+v_i) dU`.

Train only on the first N_i programs. On every training outcome z the
candidate R_(i,z) must be a PHYSICAL CPTP map, including all fallback
branches. It may be the finite ridge/Petz receiver; no optimum is needed.
Freeze it before inspecting the held-out measurements. Apply it to each
held-out small output and Bell-measure against that program's original
logical reference.

Conditional on one latent U and training outcome z, these v_i outcomes
are independent Bernoulli with mean

`p_i(U,z)=F_e(R_(i,z) F_i,U,I/k)<=f*(F_i)`.             (1)

The inequality is output-unitary invariance. The conditioning is a proof
representation of the actual joint state, not access to U. It remains
valid after averaging with the TRUE posterior of U given z.

For the empirical success fhat_i and any s_i>0, Hoeffding therefore gives

`Pr[fhat_i-s_i>f*(F_i)]<=exp(-2v_i s_i^2)`.

# Question-first B handoff: acquire the task space, not a worst-case entropy inverse

The selected question is whether an opaque noisy quantum source can supply
a useful finite recovery operation without a classical ambient model,
exact support, hidden environment or source-adjoint oracle. The first
generic finite-distinction/PGM mechanism was absorbed by strong ordinary
methods. The parity construction then showed why a balanced one-use
information window alone does not produce useful long composition.

## Completed B construction

B_SPECTRAL_PORT.md proves a finite source-copy processor for one fixed
memoryless N:k->D. It uses actual A=N(I/k) copies, a finite random rational
threshold, controlled partial swaps and COHERENT threshold flagging. On
the paid good-gap event, it approximates one fixed CPTP channel F whose
mean support rank is at most1/a+1, even if N itself has full-rank outputs.
The pass branch preserves quantum coherence and arbitrary references.

The threshold is shared across all training/program/payload uses. Every
source copy, controlled evolution, finite I/k preparation, coherent work
register, compilation error and source-query hybrid is paid. Physical
source noise is inside F and is learned; it is not compared Q times with
an ideal noise-free source. A useful mean-tail bound is tau+2d0 a. Root
and A independently whole-reconstructed this port with no mathematical
objection at its declared source/circuit scope.

B_QUALIFICATION.md proves that held-out Bell trials in ONE common-frame
calibration batch qualify the output-unitary-invariant quantity
f*(F)=sup_R Fe(RF), without qualifying a reusable old small decoder. A
finite candidate resolution budget and all implementation/gap failures
are included. A selected resolution can be used in a FRESH independent
future training/program batch; the source must remain the same. Bad
accepted service is bounded at instrument level. Conditional guarantees
divide by the actual acceptance probability; there is no free yield.
Root independently whole-read and accepted this six-section lemma.

This is not merely an information coefficient: it pays a physical
quantum-operation interface from forward calls. It is nevertheless an
ideal quantum-circuit theorem, not hardware or an executed source.
